import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (val : Int) (is_end : Bool) (left mid right : Option Node)
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def val (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk v _ _ _ _ => v

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ b _ _ _ => b

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ l _ _ => l

def mid (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ m _ => m

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let l := match t.left with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let r := match t.right with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let m := match t.mid with | some child => (view child).image (fun s => t.val :: s) | none => ∅
  let current := if t.is_end then {[t.val]} else ∅
  l ∪ r ∪ m ∪ current
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.left.isNone ∧ t.mid.isNone ∧ t.right.isNone

def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  (0 ≤ t.val ∧ t.val < 256) ∧
  -- Check Left
  (match t.left with 
   | some l => 
       well_formed l ∧ 
       !is_empty_node l ∧ -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny pruning
       (∀ s ∈ view l, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c < t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Right
  (match t.right with 
   | some r => 
       well_formed r ∧ 
       !is_empty_node r ∧ -- CRITICAL
       (∀ s ∈ view r, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c > t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Mid
  (match t.mid with 
   | some m => 
       well_formed m ∧ 
       !is_empty_node m -- CRITICAL
   | none => True)
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
   | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
   | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key ∧ -- Match Dafny byte constraint
  key.length > 0     -- Match Dafny non-empty constraint
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def chain (key : List Int) : Node :=
  match key with
  | [] => Node.mk 0 true none none none
  | c :: [] => Node.mk c true none none none
  | c :: d :: rest => Node.mk c false none (some (chain (d :: rest))) none

def insOpt (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Node :=
  match t, key with
  | none, k => chain k
  | some n, [] => n
  | some (Node.mk v e l m r), c :: rest =>
      if c < v then Node.mk v e (some (insOpt l (c :: rest))) m r
      else if v < c then Node.mk v e l m (some (insOpt r (c :: rest)))
      else if rest = [] then Node.mk v true l m r
      else Node.mk v e l (some (insOpt m rest)) r
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by
  all_goals (first
    | decreasing_tactic
    | (simp_wf; omega)
    | (simp_wf; simp_arith)
    | (simp_wf; simp; omega)
    | (simp_wf; simp)
    | simp_arith
    | (simp; omega)
    | simp)

def optNodeRec {motive : Option Node → Prop}
    (hnone : motive none)
    (hsome : ∀ (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node),
        motive l → motive m → motive r → motive (some (Node.mk v e l m r)))
    (t : Option Node) : motive t :=
  match t with
  | none => hnone
  | some (Node.mk v e l m r) =>
      hsome v e l m r (optNodeRec hnone hsome l) (optNodeRec hnone hsome m)
        (optNodeRec hnone hsome r)
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by
  all_goals (first
    | decreasing_tactic
    | (simp_wf; omega)
    | (simp_wf; simp_arith)
    | (simp_wf; simp; omega)
    | (simp_wf; simp)
    | simp_arith
    | (simp; omega)
    | simp)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t key) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  insOpt t key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : insert_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  well_formed result ∧
  !is_empty_node result ∧
  view result = view_opt t ∪ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- ### basic unfolding lemmas for view

lemma view_mk_true (v : Int) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v true l m r) =
      view_opt l ∪ view_opt r ∪ ((view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s)) ∪ {[v]} := by
  first
  | rw [view]
  | simp only [view]
  cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;>
    simp [view_opt, Node.left, Node.right, Node.mid, Node.val, Node.is_end]

lemma view_mk_false (v : Int) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v false l m r) =
      view_opt l ∪ view_opt r ∪ ((view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s)) := by
  first
  | rw [view]
  | simp only [view]
  cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;>
    simp [view_opt, Node.left, Node.right, Node.mid, Node.val, Node.is_end]

-- ### is_empty_node lemmas

lemma is_empty_end_false (v : Int) (l m r : Option Node) :
    is_empty_node (Node.mk v true l m r) = false := by
  simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right]

lemma is_empty_left_false (v : Int) (e : Bool) (x : Node) (m r : Option Node) :
    is_empty_node (Node.mk v e (some x) m r) = false := by
  simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right]

lemma is_empty_mid_false (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l : Option Node) (x : Node) (r : Option Node) :
    is_empty_node (Node.mk v e l (some x) r) = false := by
  simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right]

lemma is_empty_right_false (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m : Option Node) (x : Node) :
    is_empty_node (Node.mk v e l m (some x)) = false := by
  simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right]

-- ### well_formed destructors / constructor

lemma wf_bounds {v : Int} {e : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v e l m r)) : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256 := by
  rw [well_formed] at h
  exact h.1

lemma wf_left {v : Int} {e : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v e l m r)) :
    ∀ x, l = some x → well_formed x ∧ is_empty_node x = false ∧
      ∀ s ∈ view x, ∃ a t, s = a :: t ∧ a < v := by
  rw [well_formed] at h
  intro x hx
  subst hx
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h.2.1
  refine ⟨h1, by simpa using h2, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have h4 := h3 s hs
  cases s with
  | nil => exact ((h4 : False)).elim
  | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t, rfl, h4⟩

lemma wf_right {v : Int} {e : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v e l m r)) :
    ∀ x, r = some x → well_formed x ∧ is_empty_node x = false ∧
      ∀ s ∈ view x, ∃ a t, s = a :: t ∧ v < a := by
  rw [well_formed] at h
  intro x hx
  subst hx
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h.2.2.1
  refine ⟨h1, by simpa using h2, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have h4 := h3 s hs
  cases s with
  | nil => exact ((h4 : False)).elim
  | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t, rfl, h4⟩

lemma wf_mid {v : Int} {e : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v e l m r)) :
    ∀ x, m = some x → well_formed x ∧ is_empty_node x = false := by
  rw [well_formed] at h
  intro x hx
  subst hx
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h.2.2.2
  exact ⟨h1, by simpa using h2⟩

lemma wf_mk_of (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (hb : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256)
    (hl : ∀ x, l = some x → well_formed x ∧ is_empty_node x = false ∧
            ∀ s ∈ view x, ∃ a t, s = a :: t ∧ a < v)
    (hr : ∀ x, r = some x → well_formed x ∧ is_empty_node x = false ∧
            ∀ s ∈ view x, ∃ a t, s = a :: t ∧ v < a)
    (hm : ∀ x, m = some x → well_formed x ∧ is_empty_node x = false) :
    well_formed (Node.mk v e l m r) := by
  rw [well_formed]
  refine ⟨hb, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · cases l with
    | none => exact trivial
    | some x =>
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hl x rfl
      refine ⟨h1, by simp [h2], ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨a, t, rfl, ha⟩ := h3 s hs
      exact ha
  · cases r with
    | none => exact trivial
    | some x =>
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hr x rfl
      refine ⟨h1, by simp [h2], ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨a, t, rfl, ha⟩ := h3 s hs
      exact ha
  · cases m with
    | none => exact trivial
    | some x =>
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hm x rfl
      exact ⟨h1, by simp [h2]⟩

-- ### view update lemmas

lemma view_repl_left (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) (X : Node) (k : List Int)
    (h : view X = view_opt l ∪ {k}) :
    view (Node.mk v e (some X) m r) = view (Node.mk v e l m r) ∪ {k} := by
  cases e
  · first
    | (simp only [view_mk_false, view_opt, h]; done)
    | (simp only [view_mk_false, view_opt, h]; ext y;
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto)
  · first
    | (simp only [view_mk_true, view_opt, h]; done)
    | (simp only [view_mk_true, view_opt, h]; ext y;
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto)

lemma view_repl_right (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) (X : Node) (k : List Int)
    (h : view X = view_opt r ∪ {k}) :
    view (Node.mk v e l m (some X)) = view (Node.mk v e l m r) ∪ {k} := by
  cases e
  · first
    | (simp only [view_mk_false, view_opt, h]; done)
    | (simp only [view_mk_false, view_opt, h]; ext y;
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto)
  · first
    | (simp only [view_mk_true, view_opt, h]; done)
    | (simp only [view_mk_true, view_opt, h]; ext y;
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto)

lemma view_repl_mid (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) (X : Node) (k : List Int)
    (h : view X = view_opt m ∪ {k}) :
    view (Node.mk v e l (some X) r) = view (Node.mk v e l m r) ∪ {v :: k} := by
  cases e
  · first
    | (simp only [view_mk_false, view_opt, h, Set.image_union, Set.image_singleton]; done)
    | (simp only [view_mk_false, view_opt, h, Set.image_union, Set.image_singleton]; ext y;
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto)
  · first
    | (simp only [view_mk_true, view_opt, h, Set.image_union, Set.image_singleton]; done)
    | (simp only [view_mk_true, view_opt, h, Set.image_union, Set.image_singleton]; ext y;
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto)

lemma view_set_end (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v true l m r) = view (Node.mk v e l m r) ∪ {[v]} := by
  cases e
  · first
    | (simp only [view_mk_true, view_mk_false]; done)
    | (simp only [view_mk_true, view_mk_false]; ext y;
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto)
  · first
    | (simp only [view_mk_true]; done)
    | (simp only [view_mk_true]; ext y;
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto)

-- ### chain lemmas

lemma chain_single (c : Int) : chain [c] = Node.mk c true none none none := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp [chain]

lemma chain_cons (c d : Int) (rest : List Int) :
    chain (c :: d :: rest) = Node.mk c false none (some (chain (d :: rest))) none := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp [chain]

lemma valid_tail (c : Int) (rest : List Int) (h : is_valid_key (c :: rest)) :
    is_valid_key rest :=
  fun k hk => h k (List.mem_cons_of_mem c hk)

lemma view_chain : ∀ (key : List Int), key ≠ [] → view (chain key) = {key} := by
  intro key
  induction key with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons c rest ih =>
    intro _
    cases rest with
    | nil =>
      rw [chain_single, view_mk_true]
      simp [view_opt]
    | cons d rest' =>
      rw [chain_cons, view_mk_false]
      simp [view_opt, ih (List.cons_ne_nil d rest')]

lemma is_empty_chain : ∀ (key : List Int), is_empty_node (chain key) = false := by
  intro key
  cases key with
  | nil =>
    show is_empty_node (Node.mk 0 true none none none) = false
    exact is_empty_end_false 0 none none none
  | cons c rest =>
    cases rest with
    | nil =>
      rw [chain_single]
      exact is_empty_end_false c none none none
    | cons d rest' =>
      rw [chain_cons]
      exact is_empty_mid_false c false none (chain (d :: rest')) none

lemma wf_chain : ∀ (key : List Int), is_valid_key key → key ≠ [] → well_formed (chain key) := by
  intro key
  induction key with
  | nil => intro _ h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons c rest ih =>
    intro hv _
    have hc : (0 : Int) ≤ c ∧ c < 256 := hv c (by simp)
    cases rest with
    | nil =>
      rw [chain_single]
      refine wf_mk_of c true none none none hc ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro x hx; exact absurd hx (by simp)
      · intro x hx; exact absurd hx (by simp)
      · intro x hx; exact absurd hx (by simp)
    | cons d rest' =>
      rw [chain_cons]
      refine wf_mk_of c false none (some (chain (d :: rest'))) none hc ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro x hx; exact absurd hx (by simp)
      · intro x hx; exact absurd hx (by simp)
      · intro x hx
        have hx' : x = chain (d :: rest') := by
          simpa using hx.symm
        subst hx'
        exact ⟨ih (valid_tail c (d :: rest') hv) (List.cons_ne_nil d rest'),
               is_empty_chain (d :: rest')⟩

-- ### equations for insOpt

lemma insOpt_none (k : List Int) : insOpt none k = chain k := by
  first
  | (rw [insOpt])
  | (simp only [insOpt])
  | (unfold insOpt; rfl)
  | simp [insOpt]

lemma insOpt_cons (v : Int) (e : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) (c : Int) (rest : List Int) :
    insOpt (some (Node.mk v e l m r)) (c :: rest) =
      (if c < v then Node.mk v e (some (insOpt l (c :: rest))) m r
       else if v < c then Node.mk v e l m (some (insOpt r (c :: rest)))
       else if rest = [] then Node.mk v true l m r
       else Node.mk v e l (some (insOpt m rest)) r) := by
  first
  | (rw [insOpt])
  | (simp only [insOpt])
  | (unfold insOpt; rfl)
  | simp [insOpt]

-- ### main specification lemma

lemma insOpt_spec : ∀ (t : Option Node) (key : List Int), is_valid_key key → key ≠ [] →
    (∀ n, t = some n → well_formed n) →
    well_formed (insOpt t key) ∧ is_empty_node (insOpt t key) = false ∧
      view (insOpt t key) = view_opt t ∪ {key} := by
  intro t
  induction t using optNodeRec with
  | hnone =>
    intro key hv hne _
    rw [insOpt_none]
    refine ⟨wf_chain key hv hne, is_empty_chain key, ?_⟩
    rw [view_chain key hne]
    simp [view_opt]
  | hsome v e l m r ihl ihm ihr =>
    intro key hv hne hwfa
    have hwfn : well_formed (Node.mk v e l m r) := hwfa _ rfl
    have hb := wf_bounds hwfn
    have hLd := wf_left hwfn
    have hRd := wf_right hwfn
    have hMd := wf_mid hwfn
    obtain ⟨c, rest, rfl⟩ : ∃ c rest, key = c :: rest := by
      cases key with
      | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
      | cons c rest => exact ⟨c, rest, rfl⟩
    rw [insOpt_cons]
    by_cases hcv : c < v
    · rw [if_pos hcv]
      have hlpre : ∀ n, l = some n → well_formed n := fun n hn => (hLd n hn).1
      obtain ⟨hXwf, hXne, hXview⟩ := ihl (c :: rest) hv hne hlpre
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine wf_mk_of v e (some (insOpt l (c :: rest))) m r hb ?_ hRd hMd
        intro x hx
        rw [Option.some.injEq] at hx
        subst hx
        refine ⟨hXwf, hXne, ?_⟩
        intro s hs
        rw [hXview] at hs
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hs
        rcases hs with hs | hs
        · revert hs
          cases l with
          | none =>
            intro hs
            simp [view_opt] at hs
          | some x0 =>
            intro hs
            exact (hLd x0 rfl).2.2 s hs
        · exact ⟨c, rest, hs, hcv⟩
      · exact is_empty_left_false v e (insOpt l (c :: rest)) m r
      · rw [view_repl_left v e l m r (insOpt l (c :: rest)) (c :: rest) hXview]
        simp only [view_opt]
    · rw [if_neg hcv]
      by_cases hvc : v < c
      · rw [if_pos hvc]
        have hrpre : ∀ n, r = some n → well_formed n := fun n hn => (hRd n hn).1
        obtain ⟨hXwf, hXne, hXview⟩ := ihr (c :: rest) hv hne hrpre
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · refine wf_mk_of v e l m (some (insOpt r (c :: rest))) hb hLd ?_ hMd
          intro x hx
          rw [Option.some.injEq] at hx
          subst hx
          refine ⟨hXwf, hXne, ?_⟩
          intro s hs
          rw [hXview] at hs
          simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hs
          rcases hs with hs | hs
          · revert hs
            cases r with
            | none =>
              intro hs
              simp [view_opt] at hs
            | some x0 =>
              intro hs
              exact (hRd x0 rfl).2.2 s hs
          · exact ⟨c, rest, hs, hvc⟩
        · exact is_empty_right_false v e l m (insOpt r (c :: rest))
        · rw [view_repl_right v e l m r (insOpt r (c :: rest)) (c :: rest) hXview]
          simp only [view_opt]
      · rw [if_neg hvc]
        have hce : c = v := by omega
        by_cases hr0 : rest = []
        · rw [if_pos hr0]
          refine ⟨wf_mk_of v true l m r hb hLd hRd hMd, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact is_empty_end_false v l m r
          · rw [view_set_end v e l m r]
            subst hr0
            subst hce
            simp only [view_opt]
        · rw [if_neg hr0]
          have hmpre : ∀ n, m = some n → well_formed n := fun n hn => (hMd n hn).1
          obtain ⟨hYwf, hYne, hYview⟩ :=
            ihm rest (valid_tail c rest hv) hr0 hmpre
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · refine wf_mk_of v e l (some (insOpt m rest)) r hb hLd hRd ?_
            intro x hx
            rw [Option.some.injEq] at hx
            subst hx
            exact ⟨hYwf, hYne⟩
          · exact is_empty_mid_false v e l (insOpt m rest) r
          · rw [view_repl_mid v e l m r (insOpt m rest) rest hYview]
            subst hce
            simp only [view_opt]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

theorem insert_postcond_satisfied (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t key) :
    insert_postcond t key (insert t key h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hvalid : is_valid_key key := h_precond.2.1
  have hlen : key.length > 0 := h_precond.2.2
  have hne : key ≠ [] := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hlen
    simp at hlen
  have hwf : ∀ n, t = some n → well_formed n := by
    intro n hn
    have h0 := h_precond.1
    subst hn
    exact h0.1
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := insOpt_spec t key hvalid hne hwf
  have h2' : (!is_empty_node (insOpt t key)) = true := by simp [h2]
  exact ⟨h1, h2', h3⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
